In response, Inter decided to adopt AI solutions, which led to significant gains in efficiency and productivity.

They kicked-off the project with a proof of concept (PoC) to automate the analysis of update packages.

Samara de Souza Vilefort, IT Analyst at Inter, highlighted the efficiency of the automated process: “Because we implemented AI to validate the execution plan for update packages, the time required to analyze their impact was significantly reduced.” Process automation The solution automated the reading and interpretation of update documents, which could be up to 80 pages long, summarizing critical information in a few lines.

Leonardo Ferretti explained: “AI analyzes the document, identifies changes in the impacted systems, and creates summaries that streamlines decision-making by the analytics team.” In addition, the solution can run scripts automatically and compares the results of performance tests run before and after updates, according to the execution plan for Database Procedures, thus eliminating the need for manual interventions.
Medium-size releases are now installed in 15 hours, instead of 50, while large scale releases went down from 87.5 hours to 25 hours.
